post.originalText:
I compared 17 image models using the same prompt. 
I ran multiple generations with each model and picked the best result from each. I find it a very revealing test.

Some models fail outright. Others struggle with attribute bleeding between subjects - look closely at the beaks and faces.

My takeaways: 
• Qwen Image 2.1 needs CFG 2.0–2.5 in this test; higher values give me garbage. A good model, but still pretty raw. It really needs a Turbo/RL version. 
• Krea 2 is excellent. Can’t wait for Krea 3. 
• Some closed models are quite good, but their output resolution is lacking.
